summary: Tested notification prefs (user + admin global) and AI-assistant actionable + guardrail flows via curl + Playwright. Backend: PUT /api/users/me {notification_prefs} persists; create_notification correctly suppresses project invite notif when user's project pref is false and delivers it when re-enabled (curl verified: alice pref=false -> project invite by admin produced NO new notification; pref=true -> new project notification appeared). GET/PUT /api/admin/notifications-global works and all 4 keys (master/workspace/project/friend) are returned/persisted. POST /api/ai/agent: create_project works (alice created TEST_UISprint, visible on /projects), admin_toggle_feature works end-to-end (integrations OFF then back ON, verified via GET /api/admin/features), and admin-only actions are refused for non-admins (alice asking to 'Turn off the integrations feature for everyone' or 'Disable a user account' returned action=null, refusal reply). Frontend: Settings notif toggles (notif-master/workspace/project/friend) render and Save works; master OFF correctly disables sub-toggles (workspace becomes disabled=true and clicks are no-ops). Admin > Notifications tab (admin-tab-notifications) present with all 4 notif-global-* toggles. AI Assistant UI at /assistant: ai-input, ai-send-btn, ai-action-chip all render; create-project and admin_toggle_feature actions show chips with correct labels ('create project', 'admin toggle feature'). Notification bell present on dashboard. Cleanup: all feature flags ON, all global notif types ON, alice/bob active + passwords unchanged, alice notification_prefs restored to all-true.

minor.issue: LLM sometimes emits the action JSON envelope twice concatenated (e.g. 'Show my dashboard stats' and 'list my projects' each returned reply=<envelope>\n<envelope>, causing json.loads() to fail so action=null/result=null. Same happens with 'get_stats'. Envelope parsing in server.py:914-919 falls through to plain-text and the raw JSON leaks into the reply string shown to the user. create_project + admin_toggle_feature responded with a single envelope and worked fine in every attempt.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend returns action=null for get_stats (double-envelope parse failure), the UI shows no ai-action-chip and no stat items — the requested 'Show my dashboard stats' path is not observably working end-to-end. When it does parse (retry sometimes succeeds), it works. Root cause is backend parser, not UI.

action_items: Harden POST /api/ai/agent envelope parsing to handle concatenated/multiple JSON objects (split on newlines and take the LAST valid JSON, or use json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode in a loop). Also strip envelope JSON out of the user-facing reply when parsing fails so raw JSON doesn't leak into chat.
Consider tightening the agent system prompt to instruct the LLM to emit exactly ONE JSON object and no prose around it (currently system prompt may allow duplication).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:914-919 uses json.loads(raw) which is brittle; concatenated envelopes cause silent action loss with the raw JSON exposed to the user. Use raw_decode loop or split by newline.
server.py:1141-1154 project_invite: returning full user record (with notification_prefs) is fine but consider if that field should be exposed to inviter; low priority.
create_notification (server.py:143-154) correctly gates on global + per-user prefs; DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS fallback ensures new users still receive notifications. Good.

success_rate.backend: ~90% (all requested endpoints work; ai_agent action-parsing intermittent on get_stats/list_projects)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (settings, admin notif tab, create_project chip, admin toggle chips, guardrail all working; get_stats chip missing due to backend parse issue)

rca of the issue: AI agent get_stats/list_projects intermittent failure: The LLM model (gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations) occasionally streams the JSON action envelope twice back-to-back (e.g. '{...}\n{...}'), which is not valid JSON, so json.loads() at server.py:915 throws and the code falls through to the except branch — setting action=None and message=full (so the raw JSON leaks into the user-visible reply). Reproduction: POST /api/ai/agent {message: 'Show my dashboard stats'} while logged in as alice returned reply='{"action":"get_stats","params":{},"message":"Fetching your dashboard stats now."}\n{"action":"get_stats",...}' with action=null. Mitigation: use json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode in a loop and take the last successfully-decoded envelope, or split on newline and try each fragment.
